midnight.title: Midnight Workshop
midnight.description: A delivery stop turns into friendship: a maker helps a tired drone, the drone returns the favor, and together they brighten a small visitor’s evening.
midnight.question: Does the wordless story make the three characters’ mutual help clear? Do the reactions and pauses give the friendship room to feel natural?

debug.title: Debug Quest
debug.description: Two circuit companions emerge through the left doorway, solve a bug together, then return through the right doorway before the loop resets behind closed doors.
debug.question: Do the doorway entry and exit feel physically connected to the illustrated set? Does chase → scan → repair → escort still read clearly?
